snippet.title: Cyber Knights: Flashpoint - Official Full Launch Trailer - Squad Tactics Heist RPG!
snippet.description:
Full launched June 2nd, 2025! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1021210/Cyber_Knights_Flashpoint/?utm_source=full-launch-trailer&utm_medium=tresebrothers&utm_campaign=full-launch-live&utm_content=video-description - Cyber Knights is a squad tactics heist RPG, in a unique 23rd-century cyberpunk setting. Build your team of hackers, mercs and malcontents wisely; their stories will become interwoven with your own. Pull off heists with powerful cyberware, faction connections, multiclassing, weapon modding, stealth, hacking, and more!

Check out our reviews on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1021210/Cyber_Knights_Flashpoint/
Follow for updates & post-launch plans: https://tresebrothers.bsky.social
Join our community: https://discord.gg/TreseBrothers
Learn more on the Cyber Knights wiki: https://cyberknightswiki.tresebrothers.com/

Available on Steam (Windows, Mac, Linux, Steam Deck) now. Coming to mobile (Android, iOS) soon. Console releases are on our wishlist, depending on how the game's full launch on Steam performs.

Inspired by games like XCOM 2, Shadowrun, and Invisible Inc, Cyber Knights is a modern tactical RPG with some of our favorite elements: multiclassing, gridless movement, environmental cover, specialized overwatch, initiative manipulation and more. Independent enemy unit AI opens up a world of creative stealth options; pick them off one by one, stage diversions, or use advanced tech to sneak right by them.

Combat is challenging and in-depth. Powerful abilities, tricked out weapons, and smart coordination can give you an edge, but once you go loud expect things to escalate. Move fast and avoid getting pinned down to accomplish your objectives and get out alive.
